prompt: Pull the digits out of a messy string. Complete the extractDigits method so it returns only the digit characters of the input, in order, using a regular expression.
explanation: Instead of matching what you want to keep, it is shorter to delete what you do not want: replaceAll takes a regex, and the character class [^0-9] matches any single character that is NOT a digit. Replacing every such match with the empty string leaves exactly the digits in their original order. The predefined class \D (written "\\D" in Java source) does the same job.
hints: String has a replaceAll(regex, replacement) method -- think about removing the characters you do not want.
A character class in square brackets matches one character; putting ^ first, as in [^0-9], negates it.
Replace every non-digit with the empty string "" and return the result.
